title: Tuned twin-blower 6.25 L 90-degree V8, 1:2.5 scale model (scale 0.4), air + coolant cooled
requirements: tubes: tubular exhaust headers and intake runners
cooling channels for air (fins) and coolant (water jackets, head galleries, ports)
cooling sized to the heat load
scale model inside the 400 mm envelope

parameters.name: scale
parameters.rationale: 1:2.5 model; all other mm values are full size and multiplied in code

parameters.name: stroke
parameters.rationale: short stroke for 6500 rpm, piston speed 19.9 m/s

parameters.name: crank_height
parameters.rationale: crank axis above the sump floor

parameters.name: head_height
parameters.rationale: head deck to cam cover face

parameters.name: head_half_width
parameters.rationale: head half width across the bank

parameters.name: block_half_length
parameters.rationale: 4 x 112 bore pitch plus end walls

parameters.name: jacket_gap
parameters.rationale: water-jacket gap; D_h = 24 mm, 2.0 m/s at the design flow

parameters.name: coolant_port_d
parameters.rationale: bank inlet port, 2.65 m/s at 5.6 L/s

parameters.name: head_channel_d
parameters.rationale: longitudinal head coolant gallery (2 per head)

parameters.name: pipe_wall
parameters.rationale: gives 2.6 mm model wall, above the 2.4 mm voxel minimum

physics_checks.name: wall_thickness_min
physics_checks.formula: model wall = pipe_wall x scale = 6.5 x 0.4 (block outer wall 8 x 0.4 = 3.2, fins 3.0) >= 3 x voxel

physics_checks.name: channel_hydraulic_diameter
physics_checks.formula: jacket D_h = 4A/P = 2 x gap = 24 mm full, 9.6 mm in the model, must be >= 3 voxels

physics_checks.name: displacement_L
physics_checks.formula: V = 8 x pi/4 x b^2 x s = 8 x pi/4 x 10.4^2 x 9.2 cm3

physics_checks.name: mean_piston_speed
physics_checks.formula: v = 2 x s x n / 60, m/s

physics_checks.name: charge_air_flow_kg_s
physics_checks.formula: m = rho2 x VE x V x n/2 = 2.14 x 0.85 x 6.25e-3 x 54.17 (330 K after the intercooler)

physics_checks.name: brake_power_kW
physics_checks.formula: P = m_air/AFR x LHV x eta = 0.616/11.5 x 43 MJ/kg x 0.30

physics_checks.name: coolant_heat_rejection_kW
physics_checks.formula: Q = 0.28 x fuel power = 0.28 x 2303 kW (about the brake power, as for high-boost engines)

physics_checks.name: jacket_velocity_mps
physics_checks.formula: v = (Vdot/2)/(2 x gap x 115 mm) = 5.63e-3/2.76e-3 per bank

physics_checks.name: ic_water_flow_kg_s
physics_checks.formula: m = Q/(cp x dT) = 55.4/(4.0 x 8), separate low-temperature loop

physics_checks.name: air_fin_heat_kW
physics_checks.formula: Q = h x A x dT = 60 x 0.9 m2 x 60 K (secondary path; coolant carries the load)

assumptions: Scale model 1:2.5: geometry is full-size times 0.4; the cooling numbers apply to the full-size engine
Brake efficiency 0.30, AFR 11.5, VE 0.85, intercooler outlet 330 K
Coolant gets 28 % of the fuel energy at full load; 50/50 glycol, cp 3.6 kJ/kgK, dT 15 K
The cylinder bores are left solid in the model; the jackets, galleries, ports and pipe bores are real voids
Roots blower adiabatic efficiency 0.55, driven at 1.2 x crank speed
risks: Full-power heat rejection of 645 kW needs about 21 kg/s of radiator air at dT 30 K: this is a drag/track duty cycle, not continuous duty
Blower drive absorbs about 74 kW (first order)
The air fins reject only about 0.5 % of the heat; they are a secondary path
First-order estimates, no CFD or FEA
The model is SLS PA12: blow out the powder through the coolant ports
